variants.name: UserSim User Testing
variants.tagline: Simulated users do real tasks on your product and your rivals'
variants.description: Give us your URL and two competitors. Six simulated users, built from real voter groups, each try six real tasks on all three products in a real browser. You get a side-by-side report: where each user got stuck, which product they would choose and why, and the named fixes that would change the result.

variants.name: UserSim User Testing
variants.tagline: A user test of you against your competitors, done overnight
variants.description: Not opinions about your page: actual task runs. Simulated users sign up, search, compare and try to finish the job on your product and on two rivals. The report shows completion, time and sticking points per task, per user type, with screenshots, and tells you what to change first. Every run is logged so you can check it.

variants.name: UserSim User Testing
variants.tagline: Find where users pick your competitor, and what would change it
variants.description: We run the same six tasks with the same six simulated users on your product and two competitors. You see, task by task, where they chose the other product and the specific reason. Compare two versions of your own product the same way. Built on 89,000 real Product Hunt voter profiles; results are shown by group.

- [Tech Innovators] concern: How does Articos handle complex user journeys or multi-step funnels in its testing? | question: Is there a way to export the detailed feedback from the simulated personas for further analysis?
